children: Three planned Anthropic leveraged ETFs would give active traders 2x long, 2x short and 1x short daily exposure to Anthropic common stock.
GREENWICH, Conn., Sept. 4, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Anthropic is headed for the public markets.
Leverage Shares by Themes is getting ready.
Ahead of the
Anthropic IPO
, Leverage Shares by Themes today announced plans for three new single-stock ETFs —
ANUU, ANDD and ANSS
— designed with the goal of giving active traders leveraged and inverse daily exposure to Anthropic common stock once it begins trading publicly.
At the center of the lineup is the
Leverage Shares 2X Long Anthropic Daily ETF (Ticker: ANUU)
, designed to give sophisticated investors amplified daily exposure to Anthropic. Alongside it, Leverage Shares by Themes plans to launch two short Anthropic ETFs: the
Leverage Shares 2X Short Anthropic Daily ETF (Ticker: ANDD)
and
Leverage Shares 1X Short Anthropic Daily ETF (Ticker: ANSS)

Frequently Asked Questions
What is ANUU?
ANUU is the proposed ticker for the
Leverage Shares 2X Long Anthropic Daily ETF
, a planned single-stock ETF seeking 200% of the daily performance of Anthropic common stock, before fees and expenses. Ticker is subject to change before launch.
What is ANDD?
ANDD is the proposed ticker for the
Leverage Shares 2X Short Anthropic Daily ETF
, a planned single-stock ETF seeking -200% of the daily performance of Anthropic common stock, before fees and expenses. Ticker is subject to change before launch.
What is ANSS?
ANSS is the proposed ticker for the
Leverage Shares 1X Short Anthropic Daily ETF
, a planned single-stock ETF seeking -100% of the daily performance of Anthropic common stock, before fees and expenses. Ticker is subject to change before launch.
Is there an Anthropic leveraged ETF available today?

No. The three funds described here are planned and are not yet available for purchase. Shares may not be sold until the registration statement filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission is effective.
When will the Anthropic ETFs launch?

A launch date has not been set. Timing depends on the effectiveness of the registration statement and on Anthropic common stock beginning to trade publicly. Additional details will be announced when available.
Will these ETFs hold Anthropic stock directly?

No. The Funds do not invest directly in the underlying stock. They are expected to seek their investment objectives through derivatives such as swaps, which introduce counterparty risk among other risks described in the preliminary prospectus.
Are these funds suitable for long-term holding?

No. Because of daily rebalancing and compounding, returns over periods longer than a single day will very likely differ from the stated multiple or inverse multiple. The Funds are intended only for knowledgeable investors who actively monitor and manage their portfolios.
Is Anthropic affiliated with these ETFs?
No. Themes ETFs are not sponsored, endorsed, issued, sold or promoted by Anthropic, and Anthropic makes no representations regarding the advisability of investing in Themes ETFs.

INVESTMENT RISKS:
Investing in the Funds involves a high degree of risk. As with any investment, there is a risk that you could lose all or a portion of your investment in the Funds.

Investment in leveraged and inverse products may be subject to higher volatility. The Funds do not directly invest in the underlying stock. An investment in a Fund involves risk, including the possible loss of principal. The Funds are non-diversified and include risks associated with concentrating investments in a particular industry, sector, or geographic region, which can result in increased volatility. The use of derivatives such as futures contracts and swaps is subject to market risks that may cause their price to fluctuate over time.

Risks of the Funds include effects of Compounding and Market Volatility Risk, Inverse Risk, Market Risk, Counterparty Risk, Rebalancing Risk, IntraDay Investment Risk, Daily Index Correlation Risk, Other Investment Companies (including ETFs) Risk, and risks specific to the securities of the Underlying Stock and the sector in which it operates. These and other risks can be found in the prospectus.

For periods longer than a single day, the Funds' performance may differ significantly from their stated daily investment objectives as a result of daily rebalancing, volatility and compounding. An investor could lose the full principal value of an investment in a leveraged Fund within a single day if the underlying stock moves sufficiently against the Fund's investment objective.

Shares of ETFs are bought and sold at market price (not NAV) and are not individually redeemed from the Fund. Brokerage commissions will reduce returns. The market price returns are based on the official closing price of an ETF share or, if the official closing price isn't available, the midpoint between the national best bid and national best offer (NBBO) as of the time the ETF calculates current NAV per share, and do not represent the returns you would receive if you traded shares at other times. NAVs are calculated using prices as of 4:00 PM Eastern Time. Indices are unmanaged and do not include the effect of fees, expenses, or sales charges. One cannot invest directly in an index.
